attribution_assessment.safe_future_wording: Reuters reported at least four Palestinians killed in Israeli airstrikes on November 2: two in Khan Younis, one in Al-Mussadar and one in a later vehicle strike in Gaza City's Tel al-Hawa neighborhood. Israel's military said it conducted two strikes targeting militants, without identifying the targets, and did not immediately comment on the vehicle strike. WAFA reported a corresponding four-incident breakdown. The accounts are not additive and do not establish a final daily toll.
